name: DS Cluster S32: ALFRED Mode (Removed Option)
description: Tests: economic_indicators without use_alfred option (removed). Data is observation-date indexed by default. Always ffill() to align sparse data with daily bars.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER S32: ALFRED Mode — Removed Option
# =============================================================================
# S32 rules:
#   use_alfred option has been REMOVED from economic_indicators.
#   Data is now indexed by observation date by default.
#   Always ffill() to align sparse economic data with daily bars.
#
# INVALID:
#   economic_indicators(series_id='X', use_alfred=True)   — REMOVED
#   economic_indicators(series_id='X', use_alfred=False)  — REMOVED
# VALID:
#   economic_indicators(series_id='X')                    — no use_alfred needed

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
rets = returns(close)

# === CORRECT: No use_alfred option needed ===
cpi_src = economic_indicators(series_id="CPIAUCSL")()
cpi = ffill(cpi_src.result)

unrate_src = economic_indicators(series_id="UNRATE")()
unrate = ffill(unrate_src.result)

pce_src = economic_indicators(series_id="PCEPI")()
pce = ffill(pce_src.result)

# === Derived: CPI vs PCE inflation measures ===
cpi_yoy = (cpi - (cpi >> 252)) / (cpi >> 252)
pce_yoy = (pce - (pce >> 252)) / (pce >> 252)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='CPI (observation-date indexed, ffilled)',
    category='ALFRED Removed',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='CPI', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=cpi)

xy_lines(
    title='Unemployment Rate',
    category='ALFRED Removed',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='UNRATE', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=unrate)

xy_lines(
    title='CPI YoY vs PCE YoY (inflation measures)',
    category='ALFRED Removed',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='CPI YoY', color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='PCE YoY', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[ReferenceLine(value=0.02, title='2% Target', color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(cpi_yoy, pce_yoy))
